subject: Request: regional seat authorization for EU blended SDR/SE hire
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EU regional coverage request — blended SDR + SE seats

Hi Lauren / Karthik,

Quick ask for Q2/Q3 planning: with the London office onboarding and a handful of inbound pilot accounts in DACH, Revenue Ops recommends adding three seats focused on early funnel and technical coverage:

- 2 x SDR (EMEA) — 1 UK-based, 1 remote (EU)
- 1 x Solutions Engineer (DE-friendly) — hybrid with customer-facing hours CET

Rationale: improve discovery cadence in local timezones, reduce time-to-demo for enterprise prospects, and support two upcoming pilots we expect to convert in Q3. The attached 2027_Q2_employment-plan.pdf lays out the headcount phasing and forecasted ARR impact (baseline + incremental). I also attached a draft comp_bands_EU_Q2.csv with recommended salary/OTE ranges keyed to local market benchmarks.

Budget ask: $420k total OTE budget (headcount + expected ramp cost) across FY27; propose hiring in June (SDR x2) and July (SE). Please confirm whether we should route this as a new headcount request or reallocate an open US seat.

Attachments: 2027_Q2_employment-plan.pdf, comp_bands_EU_Q2.csv

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EU regional coverage request — blended SDR + SE seats

Thanks Neha — couple quick clarifying Qs before I escalate:

1) Are the comp bands you attached fully market-adjusted (GBP/EUR localizations) or just USD equivalents?
2) What are the proposed managers/IC ratios here — do we need a L4 manager in-region if we add 3 heads?
3) Any preference to convert a pending APAC headcount into EU (we have one unfilled CS role slated for Q3)?

If the bands are local-market and budget can be rebalanced, happy to push this to Marissa for final OK. Looping Marissa so she can weigh in on budget vs. pipeline.

-Karthik
Head of Sales Strategy
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 12:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EU regional coverage request — blended SDR + SE seats

Neha — thanks for the write-up, this generally aligns with the GTM capacity needs I flagged last quarter. A few asks before I can sign off:

- Confirm comp bands are localized to GBP/EUR in the CSV and include target OTE at 80%/100%/120% achievement.
- Add a 12-week ramp plan for the SE seat (customer-ready demo template + shadowing schedule).
- Provide proposed start dates and recruiter ETA from HireWell.

If those items look good, I can authorize opening the reqs and include them in the Q2 commit. Please put the final comp_bands_EU_Q2.csv in the req packet and set the hiring type to \"blended\" (SDR bench + SE customer-facing).

-Lauren Bishop
VP, Go-to-Market Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EU regional coverage request — blended SDR + SE seats

Thanks all — reviewed the attachments and the forecast. Approve in principle with the following edits:

- Final hire cadence: 1 SDR (London) start 6/14, 1 SDR (remote EU) start 7/5, 1 SE start 7/19.
- Comp bands: set base/OTE for SDRs to GBP 36k / OTE 62k; SE base EUR 68k / OTE 125k. I've attached req_form_1247.docx with the budget owner block filled and headcount code.
- Keep one contingency slot in the regional hiring pool to cover Q3 proof-of-concept attrition (~1 slot) — finance prefers a small float.

Amanda from HireWell should kick off outreach tomorrow: Amanda, please prioritize UK candidates for the first SDR and confirm 2-3 pipeline names by 5/3.
